title: A module map lifts to a chain map between projective resolutions
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $\varphi:M\to M'$ an $R$-linear map. Let $\cdots\to P_1\to P_0\xrightarrow{\varepsilon}M\to0$ and $\cdots\to P'_1\to P'_0\xrightarrow{\varepsilon'}M'\to0$ be projective resolutions: exact sequences of $R$-modules [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence] with every $P_n$, $P'_n$ projective [def-weil-pbc-projective-module]. Then there are $R$-linear maps $a_n:P_n\to P'_n$ ($n\ge0$) forming a morphism of chain complexes $a:P_\bullet\to P'_\bullet$ [def-weil-pbc-module-chain-complex-homology] with $\varepsilon'\circ a_0=\varphi\circ\varepsilon$.
